context: This week's 12 teams put up 1550.4 points between them, 129.2 a team.

awards.name: Best Bench
awards.text: ROK Navy's Finest's bench outscored their good sense: 64.3 points left sitting, 25.5 of it from Denzel Boston alone.

awards.name: You Didn't Lose!
awards.text: ROK Navy's Finest scored just 113.86 -- the 9th-highest score in the league this week -- but VRDNO somehow scored even less (110.12), so the win counts all the same.

awards.name: Great Defense!
awards.text: theMadgician's defense (well, their opponent's offense) did the work: Hurts Over 10.5int @-1000 finished with just 77.7.

awards.name: Mega Blowout
awards.text: Chig-a-Doodle-Doo demolished Bandits 170.06-109.36, a 60.7-point margin -- the biggest blowout of the week.
